verses.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਚੋਰੁ ਚੋਰੀ ਕੈ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਹੰਸ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਛੂਟਿ ਕੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੀ ਚਾੜਿ ਮਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jau pai chor choree kai bataavai ha(n)s maanasar chhooT kai na jai ghar sooree chaaR maareeaai ||

en.bdb: If a thief steals and yet declare himself pious like swans of lake Mansarover, he is not forgiven but is crucified and killed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਟ ਮਾਰ ਬਟਵਾਰੋ ਬਗੁ ਮੀਨ ਜਉ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਤਤਖਨ ਤਾਤਕਾਲ ਮੂੰਡ ਕਾਟਿ ਡਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: baaT maar baTavaaro bag meen jau bataavai tatakhan taatakaal moo(n)dd kaaT ddaareeaai ||

en.bdb: If a wayside dacoit declares himself kind and good doer of the wayside travellers just as a heron feels towards the fish and frogs in a pond, his claim cannot be accepted and he should be beheaded there and then.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਭਜਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਨ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਬਿਟੁ ਕਾਨ ਨਾਕ ਖੰਡ ਡੰਡ ਨਗਰ ਨਿਕਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jau pai par dhaaraa bhaj miragan bataavai biT kaan naak kha(n)dd dda(n)dd nagar nikaareeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as a lecherous person declares himself chaste and celibate like the deers of a jungle after committing adultery with some other woman, he is not let off on his statement. Instead his nose and ears are chopped off and he is expelled from the city.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੋਰੀ ਬਟਵਾਰੀ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਕੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਦੋਖ ਮਮ ਨਰਕ ਅਰਕ ਸੁਤ ਡੰਡ ਦੇਤ ਹਾਰੀਐ ॥੫੨੪॥
verses.translit_en: choree baTavaaree par naaree kai tiradhokh mam narak arak sut dda(n)dd dhet haareeaai ||524||

en.bdb: A thief, dacoit and a lecherous man is punished so severely for one crime they commit. But I am a sufferer of all these three ailments like tuberculosis. So punishing me for all these sins, the angels of death will get tired.  (524)
